An exact 2-primary and 3-primary cokernel with sharp exponent 12 is not a logical corollary of counts of the 120 exchanges or the 45 tritangents. value.rationale: Steiner pairs are the 120 natural six-plane Cayley--Salmon decompositions of cubic surfaces. A complete integral presentation of the lattice of tritangent-plane labels generated by those pairs answers a canonical reconstruction question that rational rank and prior signed-exchange counts do not answer. The index, 20 order-two factors, one order-12 factor and optimal multiplier are a natural full integer invariant, with a membership test and standalone proof; the claim does not falsely infer Picard torsion.
